#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Actual CPU inference from the stage-1 parent Head, with NO stage-2 update.

Additive, research-only: do not rewrite the historical `no_change` arm, whose
real meaning is *no split + continued learning*. The frozen candidate is a
separate counterfactual sharing original source and immutable stage-1 bytes.
No independent source/model/worker authority or prospective efficacy claim.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
from typing import Any

from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_trial as trial
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_audit as soft_audit
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_hard_review as hard_audit
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_top1_review as top1_audit

SCHEMA = "hepta.cell-meta-true-frozen-stage1.v1"
PARTS = ("old_retention", "future_1", "future_2", "ood")

class FrozenBaselineDenied(ValueError):
    """Invalid source, stage-1 provenance, prediction, or budget identity."""

def require(ok: bool, msg: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise FrozenBaselineDenied(msg)

def stable_head(hard: dict[str, Any], width: int) -> tuple[list[float], bytes]:
    """All four old-parent observations must refer to the SAME stage-1 fit."""
    arms = hard["results"]
    require(type(arms) is list and len(arms) == 4,
            "expected four exact predecessor training arms")
    pinned = arms[0]["stage1_parent_fp32"]
    for arm in arms[1:]:
        require(arm["stage1_parent_fp32"] == pinned,
                "cannot define frozen no-change from divergent stage1 parents")
    weights = hard_audit.decode(pinned, [width+1])
    raw = bytes.fromhex(pinned["data_le_hex"])
    return weights, raw

def source_metrics(panel: dict[str, Any], predictions: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]) -> dict[str, dict]:
    """Retrospective labels are consulted only after the prediction seal exists."""
    out = {}
    for part in PARTS:
        records = panel["partitions"][part]
        values = predictions[part]
        require(len(values) == len(records), "missing retrospective frozen rows")
        ps, ys = [], []
        for row, pred in zip(records, values, strict=True):
            require(pred["id"] == row["id"], "frozen source order changed")
            ps.append(pred["probability"])
            ys.append(row["label"])
        n = len(ps)
        out[part] = {
            "count": n,
            "accuracy": round(sum(int((p >= .5) == bool(y)) for p,y in zip(ps,ys,strict=True))/n, 7),
            "brier": round(sum((p-y)**2 for p,y in zip(ps,ys,strict=True))/n, 7),
            "nll": round(-sum(y*math.log(p)+(1-y)*math.log1p(-p)
                              for p,y in zip(ps,ys,strict=True))/n, 7),
        }
    return out

def produce(panel: dict[str, Any], soft: dict[str, Any],
            posthoc: dict[str, Any], hard: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Only infer from existing stage-1 parent; NEVER call optimizer or train."""
    import torch
    trial.validate(panel)
    # Independently re-run the complete four-arm legacy/numeric/route lineage.
    hard_audit.replay(panel, soft, posthoc, hard)
    width = panel["source"]["dim"]
    _, raw = stable_head(hard, width)
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    tensor = torch.frombuffer(bytearray(raw), dtype=torch.float32).clone()
    require(tuple(tensor.shape) == (width+1,) and
            bool(torch.isfinite(tensor).all()), "invalid actual stage-1 tensor")
    predictions = {}
    head_rows = 0
    started = time.process_time()
    with torch.inference_mode():
        for part in PARTS:
            records = panel["partitions"][part]
            x = torch.tensor([r["features"] for r in records], dtype=torch.float32)
            x = torch.cat((x, torch.ones((len(records), 1),dtype=torch.float32)),dim=1)
            p = torch.sigmoid(x @ tensor).clamp(trial.EPS, 1-trial.EPS)
            require(bool(torch.isfinite(p).all()), "nonfinite frozen Head prediction")
            predictions[part] = [
                {"id":record["id"], "probability":round(float(prob),9)}
                for record,prob in zip(records,p.tolist(),strict=True)
            ]
            head_rows += len(records)
    cpu = time.process_time()-started
    seal = trial.digest(predictions)
    score = source_metrics(panel, predictions)
    # The historical 'no_change' arm DOES update on new_train; never silently
    # relabel it as a truly frozen policy or compare unequal work as matched.
    historical_continuation = hard["results"][0]["retrospective_evaluation"]
    diffs = {part: round(score[part]["brier"]-historical_continuation[part]["brier"],7)
             for part in PARTS}
    return {
        "schema":SCHEMA,
        "source_panel_sha256":trial.digest(panel),
        "hard_predecessor_sha256":trial.digest(hard),
        "control_identity":"frozen_stage1_no_second_phase_learning",
        "historical_no_change_semantics":"unsplit_continued_stage2_update",
        "stage1_parent_fp32":hard["results"][0]["stage1_parent_fp32"],
        "stage1_parent_domain_sha256":hashlib.sha256(b"hepta.true-frozen.stage1.v1\0"+raw).hexdigest(),
        "prediction_sha256":seal,
        "predictions":predictions,
        "retrospective_evaluation":score,
        "brier_minus_historical_unsplit_continued":diffs,
        "meters":{
            "reused_stage1_train_rows_reported":len(panel["partitions"]["old_train"])*hard["steps_each_stage"],
            "additional_stage2_train_head_rows":0,
            "additional_stage2_optimizer_updates":0,
            "additional_eval_head_rows":head_rows,
            "additional_eval_router_rows":0,
            "actual_inference_cpu_seconds":round(cpu,6),
            "frozen_head_payload_bytes_fp32":len(raw),
        },
        "new_independent_stage1_execution_attested":False,
        "original_stage1_model_origin_authenticated":False,
        "true_ood_verified":False,
        "future_window_prospective":False,
        "total_compute_matched":False,
        "independent_ndu_selection_authorized":False,
        "production_admission":"BLOCKED",
        "authority_posture":"DENY_ALL",
    }

def main(argv: list[str]|None=None)->int:
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for key in ("panel","soft_report","posthoc_report","hard_report","out"):
        parser.add_argument("--"+key.replace("_","-"),type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        panel=trial.read_panel(args.panel)
        soft=soft_audit.load(args.soft_report)
        posthoc=soft_audit.load(args.posthoc_report)
        hard=soft_audit.load(args.hard_report)
        out=produce(panel,soft,posthoc,hard)
        payload=trial.canonical(out)+b"\n"
        require(len(payload)<=trial.MAX_BYTES,"bounded frozen baseline output required")
        fd=os.open(args.out,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY,0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as f:
            f.write(payload);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
        print(json.dumps({"output":str(args.out),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
                          "authority_posture":"DENY_ALL"}))
        return 0
    except (FrozenBaselineDenied,trial.InvalidPanel,soft_audit.AuditError,
            hard_audit.HardReplayDenied,top1_audit.Top1AuditError,
            TypeError,ValueError,KeyError,IndexError,OSError,OverflowError,
            RuntimeError,RecursionError) as exc:
        print(f"FROZEN-BASELINE DENIED: {exc}",file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent stdlib replay of genuinely frozen post-stage1 No-Change.

Never imports torch, numpy, the frozen producer or trainer; does not prove
source/model signatures, live time windows, physical hardware or admission.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys
from typing import Any

from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_audit as soft_audit
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_hard_review as hard_audit
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_top1_review as top1_audit

SCHEMA="hepta.cell-meta-true-frozen-stage1.v1"
PARTS=("old_retention","future_1","future_2","ood")
FIELDS={"schema","source_panel_sha256","hard_predecessor_sha256",
        "control_identity","historical_no_change_semantics",
        "stage1_parent_fp32","stage1_parent_domain_sha256","prediction_sha256",
        "predictions","retrospective_evaluation","brier_minus_historical_unsplit_continued",
        "meters","new_independent_stage1_execution_attested",
        "original_stage1_model_origin_authenticated","true_ood_verified",
        "future_window_prospective","total_compute_matched",
        "independent_ndu_selection_authorized","production_admission","authority_posture"}
FLAGS={"new_independent_stage1_execution_attested":False,
       "original_stage1_model_origin_authenticated":False,
       "true_ood_verified":False,"future_window_prospective":False,
       "total_compute_matched":False,"independent_ndu_selection_authorized":False,
       "production_admission":"BLOCKED","authority_posture":"DENY_ALL"}

class FrozenReviewDenied(ValueError):
    """Incorrect or ungrounded frozen-stage1 counterfactual."""

def ensure(cond:bool,message:str)->None:
    if not cond:raise FrozenReviewDenied(message)

def sigmoid(x:float)->float:
    if x<0:
        a=math.exp(x)
        return a/(1+a)
    return 1/(1+math.exp(-x))

def read_metrics(rows:list[dict],preds:list[dict])->dict[str,float|int]:
    ensure(type(preds) is list and len(preds)==len(rows),"missing frozen predictions")
    ps=[];ys=[]
    for row,pred in zip(rows,preds,strict=True):
        ensure(type(pred) is dict and set(pred)=={"id","probability"} and
               pred["id"]==row["id"],"source-ordered frozen ID required")
        p=pred["probability"]
        ensure(type(p) is float and math.isfinite(p) and 1e-6<=p<=1-1e-6,
               "invalid frozen probability")
        ps.append(p);ys.append(row["label"])
    n=len(ps)
    return {"count":n,
            "accuracy":round(sum(int((p>=.5)==bool(y)) for p,y in zip(ps,ys,strict=True))/n,7),
            "brier":round(sum((p-y)**2 for p,y in zip(ps,ys,strict=True))/n,7),
            "nll":round(-sum(y*math.log(p)+(1-y)*math.log1p(-p)
                             for p,y in zip(ps,ys,strict=True))/n,7)}

def replay(panel:dict[str,Any],soft:dict[str,Any],posthoc:dict[str,Any],
           hard:dict[str,Any],frozen:dict[str,Any])->dict[str,Any]:
    # Originals are independently replayed BEFORE any derived candidate can pass.
    hard_audit.replay(panel,soft,posthoc,hard)
    ensure(type(frozen) is dict and set(frozen)==FIELDS,"frozen report inventory drift")
    for name,value in FLAGS.items():
        ensure(type(frozen[name]) is type(value) and frozen[name]==value,
               "false authority, OOD, compute matching or prospective claim: "+name)
    ensure(frozen["schema"]==SCHEMA and
           frozen["source_panel_sha256"]==soft_audit.digest(panel) and
           frozen["hard_predecessor_sha256"]==soft_audit.digest(hard),
           "frozen source and hard predecessor must be exact")
    ensure(frozen["control_identity"]=="frozen_stage1_no_second_phase_learning" and
           frozen["historical_no_change_semantics"]=="unsplit_continued_stage2_update",
           "historical unsplit-continuation is not a frozen no-change policy")
    width=panel["source"]["dim"]
    old=hard["results"][0]["stage1_parent_fp32"]
    ensure(all(x["stage1_parent_fp32"]==old for x in hard["results"]),
           "split arms disagree on common stage1 parent")
    ensure(frozen["stage1_parent_fp32"]==old,"frozen Head did not use stage1 weights")
    shape=old["shape"]
    hex_values=old["data_le_hex"]
    ensure(shape==[width+1] and type(hex_values) is str and
           len(hex_values)==8*(width+1) and
           all(ch in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in hex_values),
           "not an exact FP32 parent tensor")
    raw=bytes.fromhex(hex_values)
    sha=hashlib.sha256(b"hepta.true-frozen.stage1.v1\0"+raw).hexdigest()
    ensure(frozen["stage1_parent_domain_sha256"]==sha,"frozen tensor hash mismatch")
    weights=list(struct.unpack("<"+str(width+1)+"f",raw))
    ensure(all(math.isfinite(x) for x in weights),"nonfinite frozen model weights")
    preds=frozen["predictions"]
    ensure(type(preds) is dict and set(preds)==set(PARTS) and
           frozen["prediction_sha256"]==soft_audit.digest(preds),
           "frozen pre-label prediction seal invalid")
    metrics=frozen["retrospective_evaluation"]
    diffs=frozen["brier_minus_historical_unsplit_continued"]
    ensure(type(metrics) is dict and set(metrics)==set(PARTS) and
           type(diffs) is dict and set(diffs)==set(PARTS),
           "missing frozen comparison cohorts")
    n_eval=0;delta={}
    for part in PARTS:
        rows=panel["partitions"][part]
        evaluations=preds[part]
        reference=read_metrics(rows,evaluations)
        score=metrics[part]
        ensure(type(score) is dict and set(score)==set(reference) and
               type(score["count"]) is int and score["count"]==reference["count"] and
               all(type(score[k]) in (float,int) and math.isfinite(score[k]) and
                   abs(score[k]-reference[k])<=1e-7
                   for k in ("accuracy","brier","nll")),
               "historical frozen score does not match actual source labels")
        for row,pred in zip(rows,evaluations,strict=True):
            x=row["features"]+[1.0]
            p=sigmoid(sum(a*b for a,b in zip(x,weights,strict=True)))
            p=min(1-1e-6,max(1e-6,p))
            ensure(abs(pred["probability"]-p)<3e-6,
                   "frozen stage1 FP32 inference does not replay")
        computed=round(reference["brier"]-hard["results"][0]["retrospective_evaluation"][part]["brier"],7)
        ensure(type(diffs[part]) is float and math.isfinite(diffs[part]) and
               abs(diffs[part]-computed)<=1e-7,
               "frozen versus unsplit-continued Brier contrast was altered")
        delta[part]=computed
        n_eval+=len(rows)
    meter=frozen["meters"]
    expected={"reused_stage1_train_rows_reported":len(panel["partitions"]["old_train"])*hard["steps_each_stage"],
              "additional_stage2_train_head_rows":0,
              "additional_stage2_optimizer_updates":0,
              "additional_eval_head_rows":n_eval,
              "additional_eval_router_rows":0,
              "frozen_head_payload_bytes_fp32":len(raw)}
    ensure(type(meter) is dict and set(meter)==set(expected)|{"actual_inference_cpu_seconds"},
           "incomplete or unexpected frozen resource receipt")
    for name,expected_value in expected.items():
        ensure(type(meter[name]) is int and meter[name]==expected_value,
               name+": wrong physical frozen budget")
    t=meter["actual_inference_cpu_seconds"]
    ensure(type(t) in (float,int) and math.isfinite(t) and t>=0,
           "invalid untrusted CPU timing")
    return {"outcome":"FROZEN_NO_CHANGE_NUMERIC_REPLAY_NO_AUTHORITY",
            "historical_no_change_is_unsplit_continued_update":True,
            "source_case_predictions_and_fp32_replayed":True,
            "additional_stage2_optimizer_updates":0,
            "additional_frozen_eval_head_rows":n_eval,
            "brier_delta_frozen_minus_continued":delta,
            "actual_host_provenance_attested":False,
            "prospective_ndu_qualified":False,
            "total_compute_matched":False,
            "production_selection_permitted":False,
            "authority_posture":"DENY_ALL"}

def main(argv:list[str]|None=None)->int:
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for key in ("panel","soft_report","posthoc_report","hard_report","frozen_report"):
        parser.add_argument("--"+key.replace("_","-"),type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        p=soft_audit.load(args.panel)
        s=soft_audit.load(args.soft_report)
        t=soft_audit.load(args.posthoc_report)
        h=soft_audit.load(args.hard_report)
        f=soft_audit.load(args.frozen_report)
        print(json.dumps(replay(p,s,t,h,f),sort_keys=True))
        return 0
    except (FrozenReviewDenied,hard_audit.HardReplayDenied,
            soft_audit.AuditError,top1_audit.Top1AuditError,KeyError,
            TypeError,ValueError,OSError,OverflowError,RecursionError) as exc:
        print(f"FROZEN BASELINE NUMERIC REPLAY BLOCKED: {exc}",file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Synthetic/adversarial conformance of the TRUE frozen no-change counterfactual.

Fixtures are NOT new Granite model forwards or prospective outcome evidence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hashlib
import inspect
import math
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_trial as base
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_top1 as post
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_hard_train as hard_train
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_frozen_baseline as producer
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_frozen_review as reviewer
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_hard_review as hard_reviewer
from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_audit as soft_reviewer

class FrozenNoChangeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.panel=base.synthetic_panel(seed=41,rule="conditional",rows=64)
        cls.soft=base.run(cls.panel,steps=5)
        cls.post=post.create_report(cls.panel,cls.soft)
        cls.hard=hard_train.produce(cls.panel,cls.soft,cls.post)
        cls.frozen=producer.produce(cls.panel,cls.soft,cls.post,cls.hard)
        cls.evidence=reviewer.replay(cls.panel,cls.soft,cls.post,cls.hard,cls.frozen)

    def rejected(self,frozen=None,*,panel=None,soft=None,posthoc=None,hard=None):
        with self.assertRaises((reviewer.FrozenReviewDenied,
                                hard_reviewer.HardReplayDenied,
                                soft_reviewer.AuditError)):
            reviewer.replay(self.panel if panel is None else panel,
                            self.soft if soft is None else soft,
                            self.post if posthoc is None else posthoc,
                            self.hard if hard is None else hard,
                            self.frozen if frozen is None else frozen)

    def test_actual_cpu_frozen_forward_and_independent_replay(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.evidence['outcome'],'FROZEN_NO_CHANGE_NUMERIC_REPLAY_NO_AUTHORITY')
        self.assertTrue(self.evidence['source_case_predictions_and_fp32_replayed'])
        self.assertFalse(self.evidence['prospective_ndu_qualified'])
        self.assertFalse(self.evidence['total_compute_matched'])
        self.assertEqual(self.frozen['production_admission'],'BLOCKED')
        self.assertEqual(self.frozen['authority_posture'],'DENY_ALL')

    def test_no_second_phase_training_and_no_router_work(self):
        met=self.frozen['meters']
        self.assertEqual(met['additional_stage2_optimizer_updates'],0)
        self.assertEqual(met['additional_stage2_train_head_rows'],0)
        self.assertEqual(met['additional_eval_router_rows'],0)
        self.assertEqual(met['additional_eval_head_rows'],256)
        self.assertEqual(met['reused_stage1_train_rows_reported'],320)
        self.assertEqual(met['frozen_head_payload_bytes_fp32'],20)

    def test_old_unsplit_nochange_is_actually_continued_learning(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.frozen['historical_no_change_semantics'],
                         'unsplit_continued_stage2_update')
        self.assertNotEqual(self.frozen['retrospective_evaluation']['future_1']['brier'],
                            self.hard['results'][0]['retrospective_evaluation']['future_1']['brier'])
        self.assertEqual(self.hard['results'][0]['meters']['optimizer_steps'],10)

    def test_real_stage1_identical_across_four_hard_arms(self):
        self.assertEqual(len({x['stage1_parent_fp32']['data_le_hex'] for x in
                              self.hard['results']}),1)
        self.assertEqual(self.frozen['stage1_parent_fp32'],
                         self.hard['results'][0]['stage1_parent_fp32'])

    def test_excludes_torch_numpy_and_producer_from_independent_reviewer(self):
        source=inspect.getsource(reviewer)
        self.assertNotIn('\nimport torch\n',source)
        self.assertNotIn('\nimport numpy\n',source)
        self.assertNotIn('import physical_router_frozen_baseline',source)
        self.assertNotIn('from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af import physical_router_hard_train',source)

    def test_frozen_is_unchanged_when_only_eval_labels_change(self):
        changed=copy.deepcopy(self.panel)
        for part in base.EVAL_PARTITIONS:
            for row in changed['partitions'][part]:row['label']=1-row['label']
        before=self.frozen['predictions']
        weights=reviewer.hard_audit.decode(self.frozen['stage1_parent_fp32'],[5])
        for part in base.EVAL_PARTITIONS:
            for row,pred in zip(changed['partitions'][part],before[part],strict=True):
                p=reviewer.sigmoid(sum(a*b for a,b in zip(row['features']+[1.0],weights,strict=True)))
                self.assertAlmostEqual(p,pred['probability'],places=6)
        self.assertNotEqual(producer.source_metrics(changed,before),
                            self.frozen['retrospective_evaluation'])

    def test_training_new_label_change_cannot_affect_stage1_parent(self):
        changed=copy.deepcopy(self.panel)
        for row in changed['partitions']['new_train']:row['label']=1-row['label']
        alt=hard_train.train_one(changed,'no_change',steps=5)
        self.assertEqual(alt['stage1_parent_fp32'],self.frozen['stage1_parent_fp32'])
        self.assertNotEqual(alt['weights_sha256'],self.hard['results'][0]['weights_sha256'])

    def test_changed_input_feature_denied_by_source_binding(self):
        changed=copy.deepcopy(self.panel)
        changed['partitions']['future_1'][0]['features'][0] += 0.01
        self.rejected(panel=changed)

    def test_forged_future_qualification_denied(self):
        t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen)
        t['future_window_prospective']=True
        self.rejected(t)

    def test_forged_model_origin_and_ndu_denied(self):
        for field in ['original_stage1_model_origin_authenticated',
                      'independent_ndu_selection_authorized',
                      'total_compute_matched']:
            t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen);t[field]=True
            with self.subTest(field=field):self.rejected(t)

    def test_changed_final_probability_even_with_rehash_denied(self):
        t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen)
        t['predictions']['future_1'][0]['probability']=.789
        t['prediction_sha256']=base.digest(t['predictions'])
        self.rejected(t)

    def test_changed_weight_with_recomputed_hash_denied(self):
        t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen)
        obj=t['stage1_parent_fp32']
        raw=bytearray.fromhex(obj['data_le_hex'])
        raw[0] ^= 1
        obj['data_le_hex']=raw.hex()
        t['stage1_parent_domain_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(
            b'hepta.true-frozen.stage1.v1\0'+raw).hexdigest()
        self.rejected(t)

    def test_divergent_stage1_across_arms_denied(self):
        h=copy.deepcopy(self.hard)
        h['results'][1]['stage1_parent_fp32']['data_le_hex']='0'*40
        self.rejected(hard=h)

    def test_extra_stage2_optimizer_updates_denied(self):
        t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen)
        t['meters']['additional_stage2_optimizer_updates']=1
        self.rejected(t)

    def test_fake_eval_or_router_rows_denied(self):
        for field in ('additional_eval_head_rows','additional_eval_router_rows',
                      'reused_stage1_train_rows_reported'):
            t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen);t['meters'][field]+=1
            with self.subTest(field=field):self.rejected(t)

    def test_fake_retrospective_metric_denied(self):
        t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen)
        t['retrospective_evaluation']['future_2']['brier'] += .01
        self.rejected(t)

    def test_forged_delta_against_continued_learning_denied(self):
        t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen)
        t['brier_minus_historical_unsplit_continued']['future_1'] += .01
        self.rejected(t)

    def test_missing_prediction_or_extra_key_denied(self):
        t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen)
        t['predictions']['future_2'].pop()
        t['prediction_sha256']=base.digest(t['predictions'])
        self.rejected(t)
        t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen)
        t['frozen_superiority_claimed']=True
        self.rejected(t)

    def test_nonfinite_cpu_cost_denied(self):
        t=copy.deepcopy(self.frozen)
        t['meters']['actual_inference_cpu_seconds']=float('inf')
        self.rejected(t)

    def test_zero_additional_training_does_not_mean_matched_cost(self):
        self.assertFalse(self.frozen['total_compute_matched'])
        self.assertFalse(self.evidence['total_compute_matched'])
        self.assertTrue(math.isfinite(self.frozen['meters']['actual_inference_cpu_seconds']))

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()

# Genuine frozen No-Change counterfactual (research-only / DENY_ALL)

## Finding and precise historical interpretation

The inherited four-arm trials intentionally train `no_change` for **two** phases:
`old_train` stage 1, followed by `old_train + new_train` stage 2. That arm does
not *split*, but its single parent Head **continues changing**. It cannot serve
as an unchanged deployed model counterfactual and must never be passed to NDU as
one. It remains a useful **unsplit continued-update** comparison. This new
additive experiment does **not** rename or rewrite old results, model weights,
source digests, wire protocols or tests.

A separately named `frozen_stage1_no_second_phase_learning` control uses the
exact saved FP32 stage-1 parent from the **same** already-trained original panel
and compares identical samples under the source's original labels. It verifies
that all four original training arms saved bit-identical stage-1 parents.
Stage 2 performs **zero Head training, zero optimizer steps and zero Router work**
for the frozen control. A real CPU PyTorch operation computes its holdout
predictions, then scores are formed after their digest is bound. An independently
implemented stdlib-only reviewer (no Torch, NumPy, trainer or new producer import)
rechecks the original soft, posthoc Top-1 and hard-trained report lineages,
original stage-1 tensor bytes, selected source identity, every posterior,
retrospective Brier/accuracy/NLL and measured-count conservation.

The original stage-1 execution and source provenance are **not independently
attested**; only its exact saved bytes are reused. This is a new comparison,
not independent new training, and cannot be relabelled as a second pretrained
model forward or a completely fresh no-change production deployment.

## Correct controls and denominator

| Arm | Stage 1 | Stage 2 | Sparse Top-1 | Interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frozen_stage1_no_second_phase_learning` | inherited old-only training | **zero updates** | parent only | true frozen weights counterfactual |
| historical `no_change` | old-only | continued joint training | parent only | **unsplit continued update** |
| `fixed_router` | old-only | continued joint training | yes | fixed expert division |
| `learned_router` | old-only | REINFORCE router + Head training | yes | learned expert division |
| `adaptive_split` | old-only | threshold-triggered REINFORCE router + Head training | only if triggered | train-time structural candidate |

Count the true frozen stage-1 model training expense **once in the shared
historical source**; new post-stage1 fit cost is zero. Its stored FP32 Head size
is a logical weight-payload count, **not** process RSS. Actual additional
CPU inference time is self-reported and the auditor checks finiteness, not host
authenticity. Frozen versus online-trained controls have very different
training budgets. Equal-input-size or per-row inference does not make total
computation, future utility, statistical multiplicity or amortization equal.
Do **not** insert a zero-work control into a matched total-compute experiment
without explicitly accounting for the extra spend by its competitors.

## Completed toy pilot (three fixed seeds; two independent synthetic labels)

`local-evidence/six-panels-descriptive.json` stores six separate completed
source/checksum-bound CPU FP32 inference and independent numeric replay records.
Values below are retrospective Brier (lower is better). F1/F2 in these
experiments are **toy test subsets**; they are not real future calendar windows.

| Rule / seed | Frozen F1 | Unsplit continuing F1 | Frozen F2 | Unsplit continuing F2 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Stable 41 | 0.071633 | 0.057210 | 0.078297 | 0.057529 |
| Stable 47 | 0.082065 | 0.056889 | 0.095600 | 0.072171 |
| Stable 53 | 0.087460 | 0.065700 | 0.087694 | 0.062093 |
| Conditional 41 | 0.342400 | 0.309380 | 0.300644 | 0.272969 |
| Conditional 47 | 0.310948 | 0.283161 | 0.330217 | 0.317399 |
| Conditional 53 | 0.303209 | 0.304466 | 0.309866 | 0.272377 |

The continuing baseline is better in **11/12** toy slices; the frozen model is
slightly better in conditional seed 53 F1. This only illustrates why the two
controls answer *different* causal questions. No algorithmic superiority or
reliable uncertainty bounds follow from the six authored synthetic panels.

## CI / evidence and admission boundaries

Run the new test suite with pinned CPU torch and numpy from a repository root:

```sh
python -m unittest qualification.cell_meta_execution_af.physical_router_frozen_tests -v
```

New isolated workflow runs this suite and additionally reconstructs all six
synthetic source → soft four-arm training → posthoc Top-1 → hard-trained Top-1 →
true frozen Head → independent stdlib replay. Retain failed evidence and source
hashes. It never downloads model weights, reads private user data, creates a
new execution owner, changes original NDU evaluator, or issues Final-use.

The actual pinned Granite 97M job remains separately queued under the upstream
PRs; no real new pretrained effectiveness result is claimed here. A future
experiment can attach this candidate only after its **original** source
binding, independent pre-label predictions, actual chronological outcomes,
complete costs and target-host receipts pass established NDU and owner gates.

Always publish `production_admission=BLOCKED`, `authority_posture=DENY_ALL`,
`future_window_prospective=false`, `true_ood_verified=false`,
`total_compute_matched=false` and `independent_ndu_selection_authorized=false`.
Do not merge into main or authorize physical Cell Split on this evidence.

name: Hepta Cell Meta genuine frozen no-change shadow (DENY_ALL)

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_frozen_*.py'
      - 'qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/FROZEN_NOCHANGE_SHADOW.md'
      - '.github/workflows/hepta-cell-meta-frozen-nochange.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: hepta-meta-frozen-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
  MKL_NUM_THREADS: '1'
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: '1'
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
  PYTHONPATH: '.'

jobs:
  actual-cpu-frozen-shadow:
    name: Genuine frozen stage1 CPU + independent numeric replay
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate with no retained credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify actual source identity before execution
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          git diff --check
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install exact CPU Torch and NumPy; verify conversion
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: \
            --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu 'torch==2.10.0'
          python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: 'numpy==2.2.6'
          python -m pip check
          python - <<'PY'
          import numpy,torch
          assert numpy.__version__=='2.2.6'
          assert torch.__version__.startswith('2.10.0')
          assert torch.tensor([0.25,0.5],dtype=torch.float32).numpy().tolist()==[0.25,0.5]
          PY
          python -m pip freeze > "$RUNNER_TEMP/frozen-environment-versions.txt"
      - name: Execute physical CPU and fail-closed numeric adversarial cases
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m py_compile \
            qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_frozen_baseline.py \
            qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_frozen_review.py \
            qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_frozen_tests.py
          python -m unittest -v \
            qualification.cell_meta_execution_af.physical_router_frozen_tests
      - name: Complete all six synthetic parent-anchored counterfactuals
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/true-frozen-raw"
          for seed in 41 47 53; do
            for rule in stable conditional; do
              R="$RUNNER_TEMP/true-frozen-raw/$seed-$rule"
              python - "$R-panel.json" "$seed" "$rule" <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import sys
          from qualification.cell_meta_execution_af.physical_router_trial import synthetic_panel,canonical
          Path(sys.argv[1]).write_bytes(canonical(synthetic_panel(seed=int(sys.argv[2]),rule=sys.argv[3],rows=64)))
          PY
              python qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_trial.py \
                --input "$R-panel.json" --steps 5 --out "$R-soft.json"
              python qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_audit.py \
                --panel "$R-panel.json" --report "$R-soft.json" > "$R-soft-review.json"
              python qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_top1.py \
                --panel "$R-panel.json" --soft-report "$R-soft.json" --out "$R-top1.json"
              python qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_top1_review.py \
                --panel "$R-panel.json" --soft-report "$R-soft.json" \
                --top1-report "$R-top1.json" > "$R-top1-review.json"
              python qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_hard_train.py \
                --panel "$R-panel.json" --soft-report "$R-soft.json" \
                --posthoc-report "$R-top1.json" --out "$R-hard.json"
              python qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_hard_review.py \
                --panel "$R-panel.json" --soft-report "$R-soft.json" \
                --posthoc-report "$R-top1.json" --hard-report "$R-hard.json" \
                > "$R-hard-review.json"
              python qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_frozen_baseline.py \
                --panel "$R-panel.json" --soft-report "$R-soft.json" \
                --posthoc-report "$R-top1.json" --hard-report "$R-hard.json" \
                --out "$R-frozen.json"
              python qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_frozen_review.py \
                --panel "$R-panel.json" --soft-report "$R-soft.json" \
                --posthoc-report "$R-top1.json" --hard-report "$R-hard.json" \
                --frozen-report "$R-frozen.json" > "$R-frozen-review.json"
            done
          done
          git diff --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
      - name: Preserve exact research evidence regardless of partial failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hepta-meta-true-frozen-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/true-frozen-raw/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/frozen-environment-versions.txt
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  prospective-base-merge:
    name: True frozen schema + prospective base-merge A-F contracts
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Construct exact prospective merge
        id: merge
        uses: ./.github/actions/hepta-synthetic-merge
        with:
          base-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          source-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          author-name: Hepta True Frozen Research
          author-email: hepta-frozen-shadow@users.noreply.github.com
          message: Synthetic Meta Frozen baseline source check
      - name: Verify merged source and structural A-F controls
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ steps.merge.outputs.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          python -m unittest discover -q \
            -s qualification/cell_meta_execution_af -p 'test_*.py'
          python -m py_compile qualification/cell_meta_execution_af/physical_router_frozen_review.py
          git diff --check
